title: Sharp rupee appreciation may cut IT firms' FY27 earnings by up to 13%: Report - The Economic Times
text:
According to a new report, the appreciation of the Indian rupee could lead Indian IT companies to experience reduced earnings. The stronger rupee against foreign currencies may significantly impact profitability, especially for firms with substantial European exposure. As traditional cost-saving strategies grow scarce, maintaining margins will be a challenge, compounded by the current economic environment affecting pricing strategies in the industry.
